scope: Supplied AI movement/pickup simulation and coordinate helper source study; no pickup support activated and ZOD-430 remains open.

findings.earlyExit: Packed32 coordinate word equality skips placement, pickups, priority and movement_taken; canonical coordinate order is x/layer/y/zero
findings.placement: Writes actor x, position.y and higher_elevation only; preserves facing and unrelated packed position bits; does not refresh cached acting_unit_coords
findings.crystal: Pickup kind1 restores HP/MP to their maxima and clears Critical in current and inflicted status bytes
findings.bonus: Any nonzero pickup adds2 when post-recovery actor is noncritical and autobattle setting is not0x11; signed16 priority store wraps
findings.movement: A changed destination marks movement_taken even when no pickup exists
findings.classification: ai_tile_pickup_update sets NONE0, CRYSTAL1 or TREASURE2 from a present occupant; later treasure assignment wins if both bits exist
findings.notPerformed: No pathfinding, inventory award, pickup removal or RNG draws in the supplied routine or placement helper
annotationCorrections: Workspace offsets0x18 and0xe30 are positive offsets from0x8019f3c4
Unit offset0x1bd is inflicted_status[2], not current-action pending infliction
Policy0x11 is AI_AUTOBATTLE_RETREAT at the pinned revision; distinct from AI_TARGET_CONSERVE_CT flag0x04
